name: And I Saw the Stars Falling Down...
storyline:
A woman narrates the story of a family and the abuse behind, and how everyone tries to convince you it's not their fault. But you don't know who to believe. You can't even trust the narrator.

Especially the narrator.
summary:
In an empty theatre, a woman narrates the story of a family and the abuse behind. Everyone tries to convince you it's not their fault... but you don't know who to believe. You can't even trust the narrator. Especially the narrator.

A drama/mystery visual novel around 13.4k words, including 20 CGs with over 12 variations in total. Includes a CG gallery! Bonus content for people who decide to use accessibility tools (Turn off animations & Sound Captions)!

There's also a secret (horror?) route hidden in the game!
